newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEIJMANS TO BUY UDEN-BASED BUILDER.
newsitem.headline: HEIJMANS TO BUY UDEN-BASED BUILDER.

text.p: Construction firm Heijmans said on Thursday it was in talks to acquire Exters Aannemingsbedrijf BV, a unit of Uden-based builder Exters BV.
Heijmans would also acquire all shares in the Exters group itself, the company said in a statement.
"It is expected that full agreement will be reached in several weeks," Heijmans said.

It said the Exters companies were active in earth-moving, marine engineering, road construction and materials trading. Combined turnover for the group amounted to some 10 million guilders annually, it said.
The takeover would be paid for in cash and contribute to group profits immediately, Heijmans added.
